rationale: resolve_asset_file now confines a document-loaded asset's local_path and file:// original_uri to the document directory (after resolving symlinks) unless the file hashes to the declared sha256, and logs a refusal instead of painting an arbitrary host file. Generic DesignIR asset-resolution hardening landed in Pulp per the 2026-10-04 temporary ownership exception; Vellum inherits it. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
